hardConstraintNote: This move adds narrative depth without altering core plot points or character arcs. It addresses a perceived lack of mechanistic explanation within the existing story.
rationale: The narrative currently lacks explicit explanation for the societal shift towards individualized naming. While implied through the loss of shared history and the rise of personal narratives, it feels abrupt and leaves a gap in understanding how this fundamental change occurred and its immediate impact on individuals.
title: The Name That Died / Carry Your Own Names / The Portable Proof-of-Understanding Workshop
